enso.advisory_text: 5 September 2026 : A moderate to strong El Niño is present in the Tropical Pacific. Climate models predict that the ongoing El Niño will continue until the first half of 2027 and may reach a very strong state before the end of 2026.                                                                           (updated: 26 August 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921
